requirements.title: Level-4 expressions are the relational-operator layer over level-3 expressions
requirements.definition: Level-4 expressions are level-3 expressions optionally involving one relational operator. The grammar admits a level-3 expression by itself or one relation between two level-3 expressions; relation interpretation is separate.

requirements.title: A level-4 expression is either level-3 or one relational operation between level-3 expressions
requirements.definition: The level-4-expr syntax is a level-3-expr, optionally preceded by another level-3-expr and rel-op. Thus an unparenthesized level-4 expression contains at most one relational operator at this grammar level.

requirements.title: Relational operators have twelve spellings
requirements.definition: The rel-op alternatives are .EQ., .NE., .LT., .LE., .GT., .GE., ==, /=, <, <=, >, and >=. The rule defines spellings only; paired interpretation and type admissibility are owned by relational intrinsic operation rules.
